tests/test_factory_deploy_dispatch_after:
def test_deploy_production_dedupes_factory_dispatches_and_serializes_runs() -> None:
    text = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/deploy-production.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    workflow = yaml.safe_load(text)
    triggers = workflow[True] if True in workflow else workflow["on"]
    source = triggers["workflow_dispatch"]["inputs"]["source"]
    assert source["default"] == "manual"
    assert source["type"] == "choice"
    assert {"manual", "factory-merge"} <= set(source["options"])
    # Runs are distinguishable, and the helper matches this prefix to find a
    # queued manual run.
    run_name = workflow["run-name"]
    assert "inputs.source" in run_name and "inputs.reason" in run_name
    assert "Deploy Production [source={0}]" in run_name
    assert workflow["concurrency"] == {"group": "vercel-production", "cancel-in-progress": False}
    assert "DISPATCH_SOURCE: ${{ github.event.inputs.source || 'manual' }}" in text
    assert (
        '"$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == "workflow_dispatch" && "$DISPATCH_SOURCE" != "factory-merge"'
        in text
    )
    # Every run deploys the checked-out tip of main, never an event SHA.
    preflight = workflow["jobs"]["preflight"]
    assert preflight["steps"][0]["with"]["ref"] == "main"
tests/test_factory_deploy_recovery.py::t:
def test_revision_is_published_before_preflight_dependencies() -> None:
    """A selected checkout remains attributable even when setup/preflight fails."""
    deploy = (SCRIPTS.parent / "workflows" / "deploy-production.yml").read_text()
    preflight = deploy.split("  preflight:")[1].split("  deploy:")[0]
    assert preflight.index("Publish selected deployment revision") < preflight.index("Require Vercel token")
    assert "deployment-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}" in preflight
    assert 'run_attempt: $run_attempt' in preflight
    assert "steps.revision.outputs.deploy_sha" in preflight

def test_recovery_workflow_uses_trusted_main_and_heartbeat() -> None:
    """Repair reconciliation is activated on failures and already-latched freezes."""
    workflow = (SCRIPTS.parent / "workflows" / "production-deploy-recovery.yml").read_text()
    assert "workflows: [Deploy Production]" in workflow
    assert "cron:" in workflow
    assert "ref: main" in workflow
    assert "secrets." not in workflow
    deploy = (SCRIPTS.parent / "workflows" / "deploy-production.yml").read_text()
    assert "--build-env COMICPILE_BUILD_SHA=" in deploy
    assert ".build.revision == $sha" in deploy

def test_reader_surface_prefixes_match_tracked_reader_paths(self) -> None:
        """Reader-surface prefixes must stay aligned with the shipped surfaces.

        The grounding guard only blocks when every changed file is backend or
        test code, so a prefix naming a path this repository does not track would
        silently reject a genuine reader-visible change.

        Args:
            None.

        Returns:
            None.
        """
        repository_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        for prefix in release_writer._READER_SURFACE_PREFIXES:
            assert (repository_root / prefix).exists(), prefix

def test_workflow_uses_main_and_immediate_trigger_without_running_pr_code() -> None:
    """Privileged automation checks out trusted main and pins merge SHA."""
    workflow = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/factory-fast-merge.yml").read_text()
    script = SCRIPT.read_text()
    assert "pull_request_target:" in workflow
    assert "workflow_job:" not in workflow
    assert "workflow_run:" in workflow
    assert "workflows: [CI]" in workflow
    assert "types: [completed]" in workflow
    assert "queue: max" in workflow
    assert "cancel-in-progress: false" in workflow
    assert "github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request'" in workflow
    assert "github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'" in workflow
    assert "github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository" in workflow
    assert "github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number" in workflow
    assert 'GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == "workflow_run" && -z "$PR_NUMBER' in workflow
    ci_workflow = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/ci.yml").read_text()
    assert "factory-fast-merge-wakeup:" not in ci_workflow
    assert "actions: write" not in ci_workflow
    assert "needs: [build, build-fork, node-auth, rust-ingress, factory-pr-auth, factory-complete-tests, factory-actionlint, factory-shellcheck" in ci_workflow
    assert "secrets.PR_REBASE_TOKEN" in workflow
    assert "ref: main" in workflow
    assert "persist-credentials: false" in workflow
    assert "factory-fast-merge.py" in workflow
    assert '"sha": head' in script
    assert 'required_checks_passed(repo, head)' in script
    assert "factory_dispatch_production_deploy" in script
    assert "dispatch_production(len(merged))" in script
    assert "factory_post_merge_closure.py --sweep" in workflow
